integrity: The probability formula is analytically derived from complete finite edge-chamber classification and a spherical solid angle; numerical sampling is supplementary. No independent validation has been claimed.
limitations: Only generic centered Haar-uniform planar sections of the regular three-dimensional truncated octahedron; no noncentral or affinely distorted cases. Related preprint on combinatorial slicing could not be fully inspected; earlier aliases remain possible.
title: Exact Haar polygon-type law for central sections of the regular truncated octahedron
